scope: One ordinary first-admitted initial position, then holding or one missing-leg buy from its remaining original allocation
objective: Mean recovery-minus-hold and source-group bootstrap interval, downside score, worst loss, actual requests and fills
limitations: No selling, external capital or guaranteed recovery execution
Uses current observed quotes and acknowledged terminal order outcomes
Drawdown/loss/exposure/slippage gates remain active; unmatched-quantity exception permits residual-reducing recovery only
Research runner normalizes adverse-fill liquidity to original venue price keys; old broker and archive remain unchanged
One cohort of generated synthetic scenarios; no real profitability or broad robustness claim
